content: The executor successfully completed the HWPX template replacement by correctly identifying that placeholders like `{{key}}` can be split across multiple XML text nodes (`<hp:t>`). The critical success factor was the robust handling of XML namespaces and the removal of layout-cache elements (`<hp:lineSegArray>`), which ensures the HWP viewer re-renders the text correctly without overlapping characters or using stale layout data. Using a namespace-aware XML parser to reconstruct paragraph text before replacement is the optimal pattern for HWPX manipulation.
